recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7836 unless Pharmacy makes a future decision to reintroduce MedicationStatement-specific HL7 v2 mappings.
issue_request: FHIR-7836 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from the DSTU1 QA cycle asking to blank the HL7 v2 mapping for MedicationStatement.identifier by removing "RXA-25-Administered Barcode Identifier?" because MedicationStatement is not MedicationAdministration and RXA administration fields do not apply to MedicationStatement.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by commit 5bb461af1063efe577bac2b8b17b6992be7560bf, which explicitly listed tracker item 7836 and removed the exact RXA-25 mapping from the old MedicationStatement spreadsheet source as part of the 2015 MedicationStatement v2 mapping cleanup.
additional_context: MedicationStatement is active in source/fhir.ini and its current authoritative source is source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml. The StructureDefinition still declares the HL7 v2 mapping namespace at the resource level, but MedicationStatement.identifier has only workflow, FiveWs, and RIM mappings, and source/medicationstatement contains no RXA/RAS/RXE/RXR/ORC mapping text. Sibling MedicationStatement v2 mapping cleanups have been separately represented on the combined branch, including FHIR-7837, FHIR-7843, FHIR-7848, and FHIR-7849.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already implements the requested RXA-25 removal. No source edit was needed, and removing the top-level v2 mapping identity would have been broader than the Jira request.
